newsitem.title: USA: Montpelier, Vt., official wants to tax commuters.
newsitem.headline: Montpelier, Vt., official wants to tax commuters.

text.p: A Montpelier, Vt., councilor wants to tax lawmakers and others who make their living in the state capital but live elsewhere.

Nocole Dewing, whose plan would require a vote in both the city and the state legislature, said as many as 11,000 people commute to work in Montpelier each day, using city services though they do not help pay for them.
An income tax surcharge would reduce the burden on city residents.
